explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1147 with Konieczny's negative answer. It is not the case that, for every irrational α > 0, A = {n ≥ 1 : ‖αn²‖ < 1/log n} is an asymptotic additive basis of order 2. Using the asymptotic notion (all large n are sums of two elements) makes the negation stronger, and it is supported by the linked formal proof. The junk value at n = 1 (1/log 1 = 0) just excludes 1.
